instruction: Can you set VLC to always continue playback where I left off? I hate having to seek back to where I was.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);
